# Status

3 items are shipped, 5 are decided and 6 are planned, as of 2026-11-26. **Shipped** means on `main` and usable today. **Decided** means designed and written down in the repository (documents and the ESS specification) with no code behind it. **Planned** means a step on the [Roadmap](./roadmap.md) that has not started. What the evidence does not show is on [Limitations](./limitations.md). This page is generated from `website/data/status.json`, the same file the landing page reads.

## Plugin

| Item | Status | What it means |
|---|---|---|
| [ui-iteration-loop skill](./reference/skill.md) | ● shipped | Plugin 0.11.0 for Claude Code and Codex: rounds of trial, measure, triage, design decision, build and gate, with hard gates on every merge and ratchets against a baseline.json. |
| [Marketplace for both hosts](./getting-started.md) | ● shipped | Install from a clone of the repository with claude plugin install uxui@uxui or codex plugin add uxui@uxui. |
| [Plugin check](./getting-started.md) | ● shipped | task check validates both manifests and marketplaces and proves the check fails on broken copies of the tree. |

## Search engine design

| Item | Status | What it means |
|---|---|---|
| [Concept and state spaces](./concepts/search-engine.md) | ◐ decided | The engine, target scopes from component to product, the two spaces, the layout-model contract, bounds and search strategies. |
| [Metric catalogue](./reference/metrics.md) | ◐ decided | 47 metrics: 16 hard rules, 17 KPI candidates, 14 diagnostics, each with a formula, unit, direction and counterweight. |
| [ESS specification uxsearch v1](./reference/specification.md) | ◐ decided | Eight domains, valid and compiled (216 declarations). No scenarios yet: 156 outcomes have none. |
| [Studio](./concepts/studio.md) | ◐ decided | The live view of a search, written as an ess-ui/1 document and generated into an application that runs on fixtures and scripted live events. No engine behind it. |
| [Ratchet preset family web-ux@1](./concepts/search-engine.md) | ◐ decided | A draft preset family for the metric catalogue, waiting for ratchet's format to settle. |

## Search engine

| Item | Status | What it means |
|---|---|---|
| [Specification round 2](./roadmap.md) | ○ planned | Scenarios for the 156 outcomes, the 13 UNMAPPED markers resolved or moved to the gaps, an independent review. |
| [Cost of one evaluation](./roadmap.md) | ○ planned | A spike that measures the per-state cost of a layout call. The design assumes 50 µs. The tool ux-search cost is written; its first measurement is still to be made. |
| [Static metrics slice ux-static@1](./roadmap.md) | ○ planned | Static metrics from an ess-ui/1 document, its journeys and its declarations, written as ratchet evidence. No browser, no layout model. |
| [First climb on a toy](./roadmap.md) | ○ planned | Two axes on one example page, searched exhaustively, a ranked frontier printed as text; then the studio. The search ux-search climb is written for theme x section order on layout model v0; it also climbs the studio's live climb page (120 section orders, frontier 42); no UI state exploration. The engine ran its first campaign on the browser adapter over the documentation landing page (144 variants, 864 renders, frontier 16, the page as shipped ranks 35th); a person's pick promoted as a pull request is not there yet. |
| [Ratchet integration](./roadmap.md) | ○ planned | Presets, gates on merge and promote, and the first loop copy moved onto ratchet and uxui. |
| [The skill on the engine](./roadmap.md) | ○ planned | ui-iteration-loop as a thin round on top of the engine: findings become ratchet requirements, taste stays with people. |
